hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(data.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git push'; then echo ''; echo '⚠️  About to push — have you scanned for PII in log statements?'; echo '   Run: /scan-pii to check before this push.'; echo ''; fi; exit 0
